findings: The actual PNG and its 680- and 360-pixel previews were viewed, alongside both old-JPG previews. The title, three carrier names, four criterion labels and central 'abwägen' remain legible at 360 pixels; the old matrix did not.

The methane card contains no erroneous CH2 formula. Hydrogen, methane and coal are presented as examples without numerical claims, ranking, ticks, crosses or a universal winner. The chemical, ecological and usage-related criteria fit the canonical evaluation goal.

The leaf and cloud beside 'CO2-Bilanz' indicate an environmental question, not an assigned positive balance: the tile is separate from all three carriers and carries no score. The lightning bolt under 'Energie' is a general category icon, not an assertion that all carriers are electricity. Neither symbol blocks this illustration, but the later learning evidence must distinguish production, use and system boundaries.

The arrows into and out of the central scale are decorative links among examples, evaluation and criteria, not a data-flow or a ranking; none singles out a fuel. The balanced pans and equal-sized example cards support an open criteria-based comparison.

The friendly, abstract comic style matches the existing landscape. The 4:3 exception is justified by the actual 360x270-pixel view: three example cards, scale and four criteria remain large and readable where the prior 16:9 matrix was crowded. The 680x510-pixel view is also clear.
